title: Ship an accessible practice brief
summary: Plan a tiny /launch page that a keyboard and screen-reader user can finish without a mouse or a visual-only deploy.

steps.title: Write the brief
steps.prompt: Write a shippable brief for a tiny /launch page. Name the user, the job, what done looks like, and one thing the agent must not invent.
hints: Start with: “Signed-in learner lands on /launch, we verify a Ludwitt JWT, then redirect to /learn.”
Add one acceptance check a screen reader can confirm, such as the page heading becoming “Launch failed” when the token is invalid.

steps.title: Outline the heading tree
steps.prompt: List the heading tree: one h1 for the product, one h2 for status, and where Skip to main content should land.
hints: h1 stays stable (product name). Status belongs in h2 so screen-reader heading lists stay predictable.
Skip target is main#main-content, not the header logo.

steps.title: Name the control and its error
steps.prompt: Name the primary control (visible label, not placeholder-only) and the error text that should use role="alert" when launch fails.
hints: A good label is “Sign in with Ludwitt” or “Paste launch token” — not an unlabeled icon.
The alert should say what happened and what to do next, e.g. “Launch token expired. Sign in with Ludwitt again.”

steps.title: List the three events
steps.prompt: List the three learning events you would fire on this page and when each fires.
hints: lesson_started when the launch or practice view opens — not only on the marketing homepage.
quiz_submitted when the learner answers; lesson_completed on the summary. Heartbeats alone do not qualify a session.

steps.title: Keyboard and screen-reader check
steps.prompt: Confirm you can finish this project with Tab and a screen reader. Check the box only if that is true for the steps you just wrote.
hints: If a step needs a mouse-only control or a visual-only Vercel click, rewrite that step.
Skip link, a real h1, labeled controls, and an alert on failure are the minimum.
steps.doneLabel: I can finish this with Tab and a screen reader
